'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Got another job for you, brother! I see the demand for backpacks, can't lose profit now. I've only got basic backpacks, so I need to bring in some exclusive items. That'll bring in more customers. You know what I mean, right? If you get some really rare rigs  and backpacks, I'll be in your debt!}}

==Objectives==
* Find [[Sanitar's bag]] [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]]
* Hand over [[Sanitar's bag|the equipment]]
* Find [[Crye Precision AVS plate carrier (Tagilla Edition)]] [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]]
* Hand over [[Crye Precision AVS plate carrier (Tagilla Edition)|the equipment]]
* Find [[LBT-1961A Load Bearing Chest Rig (Goons Edition)]] [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]]
* Hand over [[LBT-1961A Load Bearing Chest Rig (Goons Edition)|the equipment]]
* Find [[Mystery Ranch NICE COMM 3 BVS frame system (Coyote)]] [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]]
* Hand over [[Mystery Ranch NICE COMM 3 BVS frame system (Coyote)|the equipment]]
* Find [[Crye Precision CPC plate carrier (Goons Edition)]]  [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]]
* Hand over [[Mystery Ranch NICE COMM 3 BVS frame system (Coyote)|the equipment]]

==Rewards==
* +85,500 [[EXP]]
* [[Ragman]] Rep <font color="green">'''+0.03'''</font>
* 328,000 Roubles
** 344,400 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 377,200 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
* 2× [[Walker's XCEL 500BT Digital headset]]
* 2× [[Diamond Age Bastion helmet (Black)]]
{{quote|You know what? These thingies are so good I'm gonna measure them and produce them myself. They're gonna sell out instantly!}}
